scope: All four controls distinguish language attribution, expected revisions without encoded pairs, coin units and fascicle coverage. Shared IG data remain dependent evidence.
consultation_boundary: Existing source consultation receipts and limits are inherited exactly from the referenced native packets. This pass inspects those packets, not the underlying publications afresh. No exhaustive literature search, new autopsy or independent review is claimed.
rights: Original project review and bibliographic/source pointers only. Native attribution and rights remain attached to evidence; no new source files, figures or full protected editions are redistributed. Linear A GORILA refusal is not relaxed.
